text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All right,
all right. I'll get some rest, so
you can
stop pestering me. Night!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? What was I doing again?

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text: It's time for What's the Pun! Please welcome our contestant, Nice Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... I finally made it on to this
legendary
show... right? Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Nice Nature. I'm looking forward
to a great
pun battle.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I grew up entertaining people
at my
mom's bar. Don't underestimate
my humor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because she's dreaming, Nice
Nature is unexpectedly motivated for
this pun battle—and
thus begins a fierce
competition...

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
And now for the final theme to conclude
this
battle—"Training!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've heard good things about marathon

training—they say it really helps you in
the long
run!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pfft,
hahaha... marathon... the long run...

Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
There we have it! The legendary royal

straight—the flash gag! Tonight's winner
is Nice
Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, I won.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That was such a weird dream... but, I
don't know...
I feel so happy for some
reason...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After such a pleasant dream, Nice
Nature feels
refreshed.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Nooo! She was faster on the button!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Speed is the key in both races and gag battles.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... What was that dream?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the dream and its ending so
cryptic, Nice
Nature is left confused.
